nodes.label: getVendorRFQItemsWithoutToken (GET /pr/vendor/get/item/list/rfq/{vendor_code}/{rfq_number}/{vendor_batch})
nodes.rationale: Addresses the same vendor RFQ view by explicit vendor_code / rfq_number / vendor_batch instead of an email token, for callers that already know the identifiers; the response schema is identical to the token variant.
